yt_title: You Beat 1 in 8×10^67 Odds Every Time You Shuffle
yt_description:
What are the rarest odds you face in everyday life? Every time you shuffle a deck of cards, the order you get had odds of 1 in 52 factorial (about 1 in 8 x 10^67), rarer than winning the Powerball (1 in 292,201,338) or a royal flush (1 in 649,740). In this video we rank 8 real odds from everyday to impossible.

Comment your guess for the rarest one before it's revealed, and subscribe for new odds videos every day.

0:00 The odds hiding in every shuffle
0:06 Left-handed (1 in 9)
0:12 Double sixes (1 in 36)
0:18 Born on February 29 (1 in 1,506)
0:24 Hole-in-one (1 in 12,500)
0:30 Royal flush (1 in 649,740)
0:36 Powerball jackpot (1 in 292 million)
0:42 Random Rubik's Cube solved (1 in 43 quintillion)
0:48 Shuffled deck order (1 in 8 x 10^67)

Sources: Papadatou-Pastou et al. 2020, Psychological Bulletin (left-handedness); National Hole-in-One Registry via PGA.com; Powerball official odds; card, dice, calendar and Rubik's Cube math.
